senses.gloss: (b. h.); Tebeth, the tenth month of the Hebrew calendar, containing twenty nine days, varying between the second of December and the twenty ninth of January.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 2:16">Targ. Esth. II, 16</cite>. Targ. II Esth. III, 7. Ib. 8 <he>מלקטין פשרי דט׳</he> store up the melting snows of Tebeth (in their cisterns).—

<cite ref="Taanit 6b:12">Taan. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>טבא … דט׳ מנוולתא</he> auspicious is the year whose Tebeth is ugly (muddy from heavy rains); <he>דט׳ ארמלתא</he> whose Tebeth is a widow (without rain, v. <cite ref="B01056"><he>בַּעֲלָא</he></cite>).
